items.subject: Central section-property model
items.finding: The N1 parent package consumed scalar section properties in downstream checks but had no centralized, provenance-aware section-property model.
items.remediation: Added standard_core.section_model with explicit geometry-derived property models and a distinct current-SP16 Annex-D It calculator.

items.subject: SECTION_CATALOG_STAGE2
items.finding: The DAG catalog interface had an empty inline row set and did not expose a production-eligibility/source-validation state for catalog properties.
items.remediation: Stage N2 DAG adds explicit catalog provenance/validation quantities and a fail-closed production eligibility gate.

items.subject: NormCAD historical profile database integrity
items.finding: Static extraction found objective anomalous/corrupt values, including negative properties, severe mass/area inconsistencies and very large repeated It sentinel-like values.
items.remediation: NormCAD catalog is retained only under validation/stage_n2 with production_eligible=false and fail-closed access by default.

items.subject: 15К4 It first divergence
items.finding: For h=160, b=152, tw=10, tf=15 mm, NormCAD stores/reports It≈385333 mm4, equal to the unadjusted plate sum / 3. Current SP16 Annex D gives 497080 mm4 for the same plate idealization with k=1.29.
items.remediation: Current-SP Annex-D It is calculated separately from any catalog/NormCAD It field.

items.subject: NormCAD D.1/D.2 torsion variable path
items.finding: The inspected static NormCAD DSL derives adjusted Jt_ with k but the D.1/D.2 gr_m expression references the original Jt variable.
items.remediation: Do not reuse this historical route; the production Stage N2 model binds the Annex-D formula result explicitly. Runtime execution of NormCAD was not used for this finding.

items.subject: Current/effective profile catalog values
items.finding: The current SP16 points profile/product data to applicable product normative documents, but the required current product-standard table sources are not available in the current file corpus.
items.remediation: Existing NormCAD rows are imported into an explicitly interim runtime catalog so current calculation branches can operate. Each row/family remains PENDING_ORIGINAL_GOST_AUDIT; final engineering-use release remains blocked until original/effective product standards are checked.

items.subject: Duplicate NormCAD designation within family 14
items.finding: Family 14 contains two source rows with designation 17,5КТ1 (source_row_id 80 and 82) and different geometry; family+designation alone is not unique.
items.remediation: Runtime catalog stores a list per designation and fails closed on ambiguous lookup unless source_row_id is supplied explicitly.
